text: I am seeking your support to amend the parking regulations on Photography Drive, from Black Creek Drive to a point 310 metres northwest. My office has received numerous complaints regarding vehicles parked for extended periods along this section of the roadway. Despite repeated enforcement efforts, illegal and prolonged on-street parking continues to be a concern. To address these ongoing issues, I am recommending the implementation of a "No Stopping Anytime" prohibition on both sides of Photography Drive. This change will enhance the flow of two-way traffic, improve safety, and discourage long-term on-street parking violations.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on both sides of Photography Drive, between Black Creek Drive and a point 310 metres northwest.
